repository.content: Node.js + SQLite atlas website (interactive map, wiki catalogue, editor)
repository.data: server/seed-data.json: 318 allods (name, climate, size, holder, faction, category, archipelago, type, expansion, map flag; 9 short descriptions, no history text)
repository.not_in_repository: the stories, the atlas .docx/.xlsx working files and the other texts of refs/lorebook: supplied directly by the author
